name: Raw Distillate Dart | 1g
description: Raw distillate is our pure and potent distillate with no added terpenes for flavor. Raw distillate is a perfect option for those who like to make their own, easily dosed infused treats. The THC is already activated and does not require any further decarboxilation. (conversion of THCa ->THC using heat) Save yourself time and the mess that comes with making infused butter or oil.
